title: Sources: Anthropic's IPO left 50%+ of bidding institutional investors with zero shares; allocations heavily favored US investors, shutting out foreign orders (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic's IPO left 50%+ of bidding institutional investors with zero shares; allocations heavily favored US investors, shutting out foreign orders — Anthropic PBC's initial public offering left more than half of the institutional investors bidding for stock without any shares, according to people familiar with the matter.
